note: Working checklist for PSPK 1 and 2 readiness. 'probe' decides how status is derived: athena_rows (data exists), pcaf_quality (threshold on weighted PCAF score), assurance (aggregated assurance_level), scenario_run (a scenario run is stored), attestation (manual evidence in S3, default_status is used until someone attests). Weights 1-3 reflect disclosure criticality. Verify against the final standard text before relying on it for filing.

items.req: Board oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities
Management's role and competence on climate topics
Sustainability committee meetings with climate agenda
Remuneration linked to ESG / climate KPIs
items.rec: Export Director KPI scorecards with ESG weighting from the HR performance module.

items.req: Independent assurance over the sustainability report
items.rec: Engage an assurer and collect the assurance scope letter and Internal Audit workpapers.

items.req: Climate risks and opportunities by time horizon
Impact on business model and value chain
Transition plan and net-zero commitment
items.rec: Collect the Board-approved decarbonisation roadmap and sector-level financed-emissions targets (2030 / 2050).

items.req: Scenario analysis: 1.5°C, 2°C and higher
items.rec: Run the scenario engine and include the scenario section in the report (multi-framework report).

items.req: Financial effects on position, performance, cash flow
items.rec: Pull ECL by sector from Core Banking and map the scenario delta-ECL to the financial statements.

items.req: Process to identify and assess climate risks
Integration into enterprise risk management
Physical risk exposure of collateral (geo-tagged)
items.rec: The collateral register lacks coordinates for part of the property collateral. Request geocoding from Collateral Management.

items.req: Transition risk heatmap by sector

probe.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM esg_aggregated.pcaf_by_sector WHERE reporting_year = {year}

items.req: Sector exposure limits in Risk Appetite Statement
Scope 1 GHG emissions

probe.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM esg_curated.ghg_scope1 WHERE reporting_year = {year}

items.req: Scope 2 GHG emissions (location and market based)

probe.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM esg_curated.ghg_scope2 WHERE reporting_year = {year}

items.req: Scope 3 Category 15 financed emissions (PCAF)
items.rec: Several asset classes are at PCAF score 4-5. Request borrower energy data to reach score 2-3.

items.req: GHG emissions intensity

probe.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM esg_aggregated.ghg_summary_annual WHERE reporting_year = {year} AND intensity_tco2e_per_idr_bn IS NOT NULL

items.req: Climate targets and progress tracking
Green finance ratio vs. sustainable finance action plan

probe.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM esg_raw.loan_portfolio WHERE reporting_year = {year}

items.req: Internal carbon price
items.rec: Document the shadow carbon price used in credit appraisal for high-emission sectors.
